# GameAtlas v1.5.0 — Game-Level Tools & Insights

GameAtlas v1.5.0 expands the individual game view with new local tools, technical analysis, storage information, screenshots, and a consolidated mod dashboard.

## External Tools & Launch Hub

A new game-level hub provides quick access to:

- Launch Game
- Open Mod Manager
- Open Install Folder
- Open Config Folder
- Open Save Folder

GameAtlas can distinguish between supported, installed, detected-for-game, and not-detected states for tools such as Vortex, Fluffy Mod Manager, ReShade, Special K, Cheat Engine tables, and other recognized mod managers.

## Engine & Technical Details

The Technical Information section now includes conservative local detection for:

- game engine
- Unreal Engine family where detectable
- DirectX / Vulkan / OpenGL evidence
- executable architecture and 32/64-bit process type
- anti-cheat
- DRM / platform-integration evidence

The detector avoids expensive executable content scans during normal navigation so game selection remains responsive.

## Storage & Installation

A new Storage & Installation card shows:

- installed size
- install file count
- install drive
- free / total drive capacity
- drive usage
- main executable size
- save-data size
- config-data size
- largest installed files

The main install-size calculation reuses the existing local installation scan instead of walking the game directory twice.

## Screenshot Browser

GameAtlas can now detect Steam screenshots using each game's Steam App ID and also checks a small set of common screenshot folders.

The card shows:

- screenshot count
- newest screenshot
- newest screenshot timestamp
- screenshot source
- screenshot folder

Actions include Open Folder and Open Newest.

## Mod Dashboard

The Mods & Enhancements section is now a consolidated dashboard covering:

- RenoDX
- Luma
- Vortex
- Fluffy Mod Manager
- ReShade
- Special K
- other recognized local mod-manager evidence

Provider support and local installation evidence remain clearly separated.

## Performance & Reliability

v1.5 includes performance work for local technical detection. Expensive brute-force executable scanning was removed from the normal inspection path after testing showed it could stall the UI on large games.

Local installation results continue to be cached and shared between game-level panels.

## Compatibility

This release preserves the existing GameAtlas application identity, updater identity, data keys, local application-data location, settings, favorites, tags, hidden games, saved views, analysis data, and backup data.

**Platform:** Windows
